body:
The Owyhee Blue Opal Point is a powerful energetic ally when you’re seeking to direct calm, focus your energy, or create a clear channel for healing. While tumbled stones and touchstones offer support through presence, a crystal point helps you concentrate that support with intention.

Place it on your altar, bedside table, or work desk to shift the energy in your space. Use it in breathwork or meditation to draw emotional overwhelm out of the body and back into balance. This is a piece for those who want subtle power with pinpoint purpose—quiet, intentional, and deeply restorative.
